title: 1928 LA manor once owned by Gene Hackman asks $5.995M
summary_full: A nearly 100-year-old English-style manor in Woodland Hills is listed for sale at $5.995 million. Originally built in 1928, the property has hosted notable owners like Michael Curtiz and Gene Hackman. The manor features a cobblestone driveway, extensive gardens, and original architectural details that reflect its rich history. Since its last sale in 1994 for $1.71 million, the property's value has significantly increased.
